manual.warlockery.preamble.title: 这本魔典教你啥
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.title: 生物群落之书，扩展版
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.preamb: 每片土地都有自己的小脾气。这本魔典教你记住眼前的生物群系，再拿这份记忆发动季候挪移仪式。先看入门，再翻到你想召来的那片天地，别让地脉当场翻车。
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.overvi: 这些章节介绍熟悉的土地。即使某个已注册生态域在这里没有自己的章节，只要你亲自到访，这本书仍能记住它。
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.biome_: 蹲下并对想记住之生物群落中的方块用这本书。书会保存该生物群落，并把名称加进自己的名字。绑定新地点会取代旧记忆，不需要纸张。
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.shifti: 把有名称的书带到季节转移仪式。普通时从1乘1区块开始，有先知石与集会时从3乘3开始。最多三颗地狱之星，每颗增加一圈。普通尺寸为1、3、5、7，增强后为3、5、7、9。书会保留，星星会被消耗。
manual.warlockery.codex.title: 术士的坩埚魔典
manual.warlockery.codex.preamble: 这是你的坩埚开锅指南。先把锅烧热，材料按顺序下，最后再决定药酿怎么出手。每种药酿都有单独一页，效果和配方都写明白，照着整基本不会炸锅。
manual.warlockery.codex.custom_brews: 将标记的灵药成分依序加入加热的符文大锅中。
manual.warlockery.codex.circle_brewing: 在符文大锅同一高度画出的粉笔圆环能影响酿造。小型5x5圆环需要12个符号，中型9x9圆环需要24个。仪式粉笔能稳定大锅并降低失控风险；炼狱粉笔会提高效力，但也带来危险。两种尺寸可以用不同粉笔，但每一圈都得完整且只用一种粉笔。大锅上方的文字会指出缺漏或混杂的符号。
manual.warlockery.codex.delivery: 搞定的药液可以饮用、投掷、化为气体、铺成液体，或绑定装置。蝙蝠毛制成气体，苦艾制成液体，僵尸头则将药液绑定到按钮、拉杆、门或压力板。
manual.warlockery.codex.diagnostics: 浮动显示器会报告无效订单、容量、热量、水、电力和输出空间。
manual.warlockery.immortal.title: 不死者观察笔记
manual.warlockery.immortal.preamble: 这是成为不死吸血鬼的进阶攻略。开头几课能直接读，后面的秘密却被撕走了。手里拿着同一本笔记，用一张残页就只能缝回下一课。按顺序补齐九张，整条血族路线才会完全解锁；残页不会串到别的书里乱开章节。
manual.warlockery.immortal.initiation: 夜色不会白送独行者永生。先找到 Nami。她可以接受结缘并换上新名字，这段婚约会永久护住她，让血之觐见直接失效。只有未婚的 Nami 才能变成 Naamah，Naamah 永远不能结婚。后面的秘闻要把撕裂书页一张张缝回本书才会解锁。
manual.warlockery.immortal.blood: 鲜血是不死者唯一的饥饿，也是第二颗心脏。普通食物既不能治疗吸血鬼，也不会让吸血鬼挨饿。你可以从符合条件的活物身上进食、饮用温热之血，或从鲜血坩埚中汲取力量。这份秘法储量取代饥饿值：耗尽时为“饥渴”，中等储量时为“满足”，完全充满则会唤醒“血盛”再生。只要储量至少还有九成，血盛就会持续；每恢复半颗心会消耗最大鲜血的百分之一。花掉最后一滴血会重新触发储量耗尽的旧有惩罚，所以施展昂贵的恩赐前先去狩猎。
manual.warlockery.immortal.weaknesses: 当地的阳光会剥去黑夜的庇护；未遮住头部的吸血鬼即使拥有抗火效果也会受伤。雨水、水中、细雪、头部遮盖和没有太阳的维度都能保护你。火焰、神圣弩箭、木桩弩箭、刺入沉睡心脏的木桩、白银弩箭、银制武器、大蒜结界以及充能的太阳手雷，都能穿透可削弱普通钢铁的防护。棺材能提供合适的白昼休息。吸血鬼服饰只代表地位，并不允许你无视所有弱点。狼人猎手和携带白银弩箭的掠夺者也能杀死超自然猎物。若要舍弃鲜血，请束缚吸血鬼的感应印记，并完成破咒仪式：吸血鬼化。
manual.warlockery.biomes.title: 生物群落之书
manual.warlockery.biomes.preamble: 每种生物群系都有一缕地灵。这本书会告诉你各片天地长啥样，也教你怎么把它们的记忆交给季候挪移仪式。想把哪片风土摇过来，就先翻它的章节。
manual.warlockery.biomes.overview: 这些章节介绍熟悉的土地。即使某个已注册生态域在这里没有自己的章节，只要你亲自到访，这本书仍能记住它。
manual.warlockery.biomes.biome_notes: 蹲下并对方块用生物群落之书，就能把书绑定到该生物群落。书名会显示记忆。仪式普通时从1乘1开始，有先知石与集会时从3乘3开始。最多消耗三颗地狱之星，每颗增加一圈。书会保留。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.title: Warlockery：召唤与恋物癖
manual.warlockery.conjuration.preamble: 这本魔典专讲摇人、召灵和唤醒绑定物。生物、魔偶、雕像和织梦器都有自己的短课。先读明白再开门请客，不然来的东西可不一定讲武德。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.summoning: 召唤仪式用标记试剂、粉笔图案、祭坛魔法和世界条件。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetishes: 恋物癖可以配置标记焦点并报告其活动模式。
manual.warlockery.circles.title: Warlockery：圆圈魔法
manual.warlockery.circles.preamble: 这本魔典教你画粉笔法阵。照图铺好圆环，摆齐供物，再点金色阵心开仪式。选中仪式后会显示法阵图、材料、祭坛能量和还差啥，绿勾全亮再开，稳得很。
manual.warlockery.circles.chalk: 仪式粉笔绘出凡俗魔法的苍白线条，炼狱粉笔描绘火焰与恶魔，帷幕粉笔则为灵魂与梦境开启隐密道路。金色粉笔标示法阵的核心；放置时蹲下可改画一般的金色圆环符文。在金色中心用先知石，会召来所有由你招募、仍存活且已载入的圆环法师。他们会聚集在法阵周围，并与玩家一同计入集会人数；未绑定的圆环法师不会计入。
manual.warlockery.circles.ritual_ui: 在圆圈中心用奥术焦点来选仪式并检查每项要求。
manual.warlockery.circles.power: 在施法开始之前，附近的祭坛得提供所显示的能量。
manual.warlockery.distilling.title: Warlockery：蒸馏
manual.warlockery.distilling.preamble: 这本魔典教你用蒸馏器薅出材料里藏着的魔性精华。塞进对应材料、陶罐和祭坛能量，每页都会画清楚进什么、出什么，省得炼完只收获一脸问号。
manual.warlockery.distilling.inputs: 酿酒厂配方接受项目和流体标签以进行跨模式输入。
manual.warlockery.distilling.outputs: 输出显示报告阻塞的插槽和每个遗失的输入。
manual.warlockery.distilling.automation: 侧面物品和流体功能允许相容的管道实现机器自动化。
manual.warlockery.herbology.title: Warlockery：草药学
manual.warlockery.herbology.preamble: 这是术士的种田魔典。每种植物都有独立小课，告诉你它在哪长、怎么收、能拿来整什么魔法。最后还有安全突变指南，种歪了也别急着把花园扬了。
manual.warlockery.herbology.crops: 魔法作物用锻造和香草作物、种子、花朵和纤维标签。
manual.warlockery.herbology.mutations: 突变需要显示附近的植物、催化剂和世界条件。
manual.warlockery.herbology.toad_mutatio: 蟾蜍突变：在水面上的蜘蛛网上用小树枝，放置两个或多个充满粘液的小动物圈套，四个对角的 Grasspers，持有三个 Mutandis Extremis 和一个带电的协调石，以及附近的一只猫或豹猫。每个装满的圈套都会形成一只蟾蜍。
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_mu: 梦根突变：将四只成熟的曼德拉草放置在主射线上，并放置四只对角线的 Grasspers，持有两颗 Mutandis Extremis、聚焦意志和一块带电的协调石，围绕著水面上的蜘蛛网。带上爬行者和活的曼德拉草，然后用小树枝改变所有四种作物。
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_bu: 掉落的梦根球茎会在大约三秒后醒来，并寻找其掉落者或最近的生存玩家。当您想要农作物时，直接种植球茎植物。
manual.warlockery.herbology.safe_harvest: 带有标签的安全魔法植物工具，例如Boline，可以防止危险的收获效应。
manual.warlockery.infusions.title: Warlockery：药剂和魔法输液
manual.warlockery.infusions.preamble: 这本魔典教你把长效魔力塞进人或物件里。先选路线，备齐图里的供物，还得盯住自己的魔力槽。后面的章节会逐个讲清个人灌注和物品灌注。
manual.warlockery.infusions.paths: 魔法注入仪式赋予了一条具有自身力量和被动机制的魔法之路。
manual.warlockery.infusions.focus: 奥术焦点用用者、生物或物块上选定的路径。
manual.warlockery.infusions.reserve: 每条路径都会消耗储存的魔法，并且可以透过仪式和特定于路径的操作来重新充电。
manual.warlockery.fumes.title: Warlockery：收集烟雾
manual.warlockery.fumes.preamble: 这本魔典教你抓住会溜走的魔法烟气。给炼金炉喂材料，备好烧制陶罐，也给产物留空位。每页都标出原料、烟气以及剩下的灰或食物，别把炉子塞到爆仓。
manual.warlockery.fumes.oven: 炼金炉将标示的来源加工成罐子、灰烬和烟雾副产品。
manual.warlockery.fumes.jars: 黏土罐提供烟雾输出的容器。
manual.warlockery.fumes.funnels: 带标签的漏斗升级改进了烟雾回收和过滤输出选。
manual.warlockery.symbology.title: Warlockery：符号系统
manual.warlockery.symbology.preamble: 这本魔典讲符号、石头、枝条和法器里封着的魔力。每件工具能指向什么、会烧多少魔力，都有明账。先从奥术焦点入门，再翻你手里那件家伙的专页。
manual.warlockery.symbology.focus: 神秘分支和奥术焦点提供现代的基于点击的法术控制。
manual.warlockery.symbology.gestures: 主要、次要、方块、自我和生物互动取代了脆弱的滑鼠手势。
manual.warlockery.symbology.deflection: 魔法路径防御用标记的伤害和生物家族来实现跨模组相容性。
manual.warlockery.torn_page.title: 残页
manual.warlockery.torn_page.immortal_fra: 残破字迹提到一轮被邀约染红的月：在满月下呼唤 Naamah，击败回应召唤的存在，再把她的血献给另一位女族长。单看这张纸不会继续爆料；拿着《不死者观察笔记》使用残页，它才会缝回下一段缺失内容。
manual.warlockery.codex.antidotes.title: 驱除毒素
manual.warlockery.codex.antidotes: 万用解毒剂由虚无催化剂、感染酿液与衰败酿液制成。饮用后可解除中毒与凋零，并保留有益效果。

ritual.warlockery.banish_demon.title: 放逐仪式
ritual.warlockery.banish_demon.descripti: 将敌对的超自然生物驱逐出仪式区域。
将附近敌对的超自然生物从护身符圈中驱逐出去。
ritual.warlockery.barrier.title: 保护仪式
ritual.warlockery.barrier.description: 在圆圈周围升起一个短暂的魔法结界。
ritual.warlockery.barrier_large.title: 更强保护仪式
ritual.warlockery.barrier_large.descript: 为女巫会及其盟友建立一个广阔的魔法结界。
ritual.warlockery.barrier_portable.title: 便携式保护仪式
ritual.warlockery.barrier_portable.descr: 提供一分钟的强力防护。
ritual.warlockery.bind_circle.title: 魔法连接仪式：圆形护身符
ritual.warlockery.bind_circle.descriptio: 将备齐的圆圈拉成护身符，用于便携式仪式。
ritual.warlockery.bind_circle_portable.t: 便携式魔法仪式连结：圆形
ritual.warlockery.bind_circle_portable.d: 刷新圆形护身符，以便在远离永久祭坛的地方用。
ritual.warlockery.bind_death.title: 魔法连结仪式：死亡
ritual.warlockery.bind_death.description: 消耗每个幽灵宿主的五个神奇相连的生物，透过面纱呼唤死亡。
ritual.warlockery.bind_familiar.title: 魔法连结仪式：熟悉
ritual.warlockery.bind_familiar.descript: 加强并保护在圈子中熟悉的地位。
ritual.warlockery.bind_fetish.title: 魔法连结仪式：恋物癖
ritual.warlockery.bind_fetish.descriptio: Bind a Scarecrow using Spectral Dust and a complete group of living spirits. Their combination determines its bound mode. Use the separate Witch's Ladder rite to bind a ladder.
ritual.warlockery.bind_trent.title: 魔法束缚仪式：树人雕像
ritual.warlockery.bind_trent.description: Bind a Trent Effigy using Spectral Dust and a complete group of living spirits. Follow the group list below to choose its bound mode.
ritual.warlockery.bind_spectral.title: 魔法连结仪式：幽灵生物
ritual.warlockery.bind_spectral.descript: 将幽灵生物凝结成焕然一新的幽灵石。
ritual.warlockery.bind_statue_player.des: 将女神雕像与生物的魔法印记神奇地连结起来。
ritual.warlockery.bind_waystone.title: 魔法连结仪式：Waystone
ritual.warlockery.bind_waystone.descript: 神奇地将路石连结到该圆圈的位置。
ritual.warlockery.bind_waystone_player.t: 魔法连结仪式：血迹路石
ritual.warlockery.bind_waystone_player.d: 创造一个透过魔法连结的生物印记神奇连结的路石。
ritual.warlockery.bind_waystone_portable: 神奇地将路石连接到护身符驱动的圆圈上。
ritual.warlockery.blight.title: 枯萎诅咒
ritual.warlockery.blight.description: 毁坏农作物和花卉，使土地变得荒芜。
ritual.warlockery.blindness.title: 失明的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.call_beasts.title: 野兽召唤仪式
ritual.warlockery.call_beasts.descriptio: 将附近的动物吸引到典礼圈中。
ritual.warlockery.call_familiar.title: 召唤仪式：熟悉
ritual.warlockery.call_familiar.descript: 将熟悉的人召唤回女巫身边。
ritual.warlockery.charge_attuned_stone.d: 用集中的祭坛魔法为协调石充能。
ritual.warlockery.climate_change.title: 季节更替仪式
ritual.warlockery.climate_change.descrip: 把完整区块变成已绑定生态域之书记住的生态域。预见之石、五名参与者与最多三颗地狱之星能扩大仪式。
ritual.warlockery.cook_food.title: 炙烤仪式
ritual.warlockery.cook_food.description: 厨师们将生食丢到仪式区。
ritual.warlockery.copy_waystone.title: 魔法连结仪式：复制 Waystone
ritual.warlockery.copy_waystone.descript: 将魔法连结的位置复制到第二个路石上。
ritual.warlockery.copy_waystone_portable: 便携式魔法仪式连结：复制 Waystone
在护身符驱动的圆圈中复制一个神奇连结的位置。
ritual.warlockery.corrupt_doll.title: 腐化娃娃的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.corrupt_doll.descripti: 除非诅咒守卫或玩偶守卫拦截，否则最多可伤害三个魔法连结的保护玩偶。
ritual.warlockery.cure_heat_metal.title: 破咒仪式：金属灼烧
ritual.warlockery.cure_heat_metal.descri: 冷却灼烧的金属，并净化与印记魔法相连的存在。
ritual.warlockery.cure_insanity.title: 破咒仪式：疯狂
ritual.warlockery.cure_insanity.descript: 净化与印记魔法相连的存在的疯狂。
ritual.warlockery.cure_misfortune.title: 破咒仪式：不幸
ritual.warlockery.cure_misfortune.descri: 净化与印记魔法相连的存在的不幸。
ritual.warlockery.cure_nightmare.title: 破咒仪式：恶梦
ritual.warlockery.cure_nightmare.descrip: 结束了与印记魔法相连的存在的清醒噩梦。
ritual.warlockery.cure_overheating.title: 破咒仪式：过热
ritual.warlockery.cure_overheating.descr: 冷却并净化与印记魔法相连的存在。
ritual.warlockery.cure_sinking.title: 破咒仪式：沉没
ritual.warlockery.cure_sinking.descripti: 解除与印记魔法相连的存在的沉没诅咒。
ritual.warlockery.cure_vampire.title: 破咒仪式：吸血鬼
ritual.warlockery.cure_vampire.descripti: 从与印记魔法相连的吸血鬼中净化吸血鬼。
ritual.warlockery.cure_wolf.title: 破咒仪式：狼人术
ritual.warlockery.cure_wolf.description: 净化与印记魔法相连的狼人的狼性。
ritual.warlockery.deathly_veil.title: 死亡面纱
ritual.warlockery.deathly_veil.descripti: 将圆圈内的生物暂时隐藏起来，让一般人看不见。
ritual.warlockery.drain_growth.title: 排水增长
ritual.warlockery.drain_growth.descripti: Drain nearby plant growth through a circle working. This rite requires the altar power listed below.
ritual.warlockery.eclipse.title: 全食仪式
ritual.warlockery.eclipse.description: 天空变暗，附近的生物笼罩在超自然的黑暗中。
ritual.warlockery.eclipse_portable.title: 便携式全食仪式
ritual.warlockery.eclipse_portable.descr: 圆形护身符使天空变暗。
ritual.warlockery.fertility.title: 生育仪式
ritual.warlockery.fertility.description: 种植相容的植物，治愈中毒、恶心和失明，并恢复僵尸村民。
ritual.warlockery.fertility_portable.des: 种植相容的植物并用圆形护身符治愈附近的玩家和僵尸村民。
ritual.warlockery.forestation.title: 森林仪式
ritual.warlockery.forestation.descriptio: 将相容的标记树苗放置并强制生长到周围的林地。
ritual.warlockery.fortification_of_the_c: Fortify nearby undead at night through this circle working. Keep the Necromantic Stone near the heart; the bones are consumed. A Brazier is not required for this rite.
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_infernal.desc: 将外部字形转变为地狱粉笔。
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_ritual.title: 字形转变仪式：仪式
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_ritual.descri: 将外部字形转变为仪式粉笔。
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_the_veil.desc: 将外部字形转换为 the_veil 粉笔。
ritual.warlockery.graveyard_mist.title: 墓园迷雾
ritual.warlockery.graveyard_mist.descrip: 用灰烬填满圆圈，隐藏并恢复不死生物，同时使生者失明。
ritual.warlockery.hell_on_earth.title: 人间地狱的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hell_on_earth.descript: 在法阵或额外的已绑定路石处开启地狱裂隙，并由法阵旁祭坛的能量维持。
ritual.warlockery.hex_insanity.title: 疯狂诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_insanity.descripti: 用幻象和黑暗折磨印记魔法连结的存在。
ritual.warlockery.hex_misfortune.title: 不幸的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_misfortune.descrip: 诅咒与印记魔法相连的存在持续带来厄运。
ritual.warlockery.hex_nightmare.title: 觉醒噩梦的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_nightmare.descript: 困扰著与黑暗和饥饿有著神奇联系的印记存在。
ritual.warlockery.hex_overheating.title: 过热诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_overheating.descri: 使与印记魔法相连的存在因地狱热而燃烧。
ritual.warlockery.hex_sinking.title: 沉没诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_sinking.descriptio: 为与印记魔法相连的存在带来压倒性的超自然重量。
ritual.warlockery.hex_wolf.title: 狼的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.hex_wolf.description: 在满月和集会满的情况下，赋予与印记魔法相连的凡人狼性。
ritual.warlockery.ice_shell.title: 冰冷扩张仪式
ritual.warlockery.ice_shell.description: 在圆圈周围建造一个空心的浮冰球。
ritual.warlockery.imprisonment.title: 入狱仪式
ritual.warlockery.imprisonment.descripti: 削弱圆圈内的移动能力，使被捕获的敌人没法逃脱。
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_grave.titl: 魔法注入仪式：坟墓长生不老药
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_grave.desc: Make a Grave Brew from the listed offerings. The completed brew appears above the heart after the cast.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_soaring.ti: 魔法注入仪式：飞翔药剂
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_soaring.de: Make a Soaring Brew from the listed offerings. The completed brew appears above the heart after the cast.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_broom.title: 魔法注入仪式：魔法扫帚
ritual.warlockery.infuse_broom.descripti: 用普通扫帚和飞翔药膏创造一把附魔扫帚。
ritual.warlockery.infuse_crystal_ball.de: 注入石英球以进行占卜。
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mirror.title: 魔法注入仪式：镜子
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mirror.descript: 将精心制作的镜面凝结成便携式地狱反射。
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mystic_branch.t: 魔法注入仪式：神秘之枝
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mystic_branch.d: 为树枝注入集中的自然魔法。
ritual.warlockery.infuse_seer_stone.desc: 注入一块石头，用于族群间的交流。
ritual.warlockery.infusion_earth.title: 魔法注入仪式：大地
ritual.warlockery.infusion_earth.descrip: 为圈子里的人注入石头般的耐力。
ritual.warlockery.infusion_ender.title: 魔法注入仪式：面纱
ritual.warlockery.infusion_ender.descrip: 给圈子里的人注入超凡脱俗的速度。
ritual.warlockery.infusion_hell.title: 魔法注入仪式：地狱之火
ritual.warlockery.infusion_hell.descript: 为圈内的人提供免受火焰伤害的保护。
ritual.warlockery.infusion_light.title: 魔法注入仪式：光
ritual.warlockery.infusion_light.descrip: 为圈子里的人注入光芒。
ritual.warlockery.infusion_sky.title: 魔法注入仪式：天空
ritual.warlockery.infusion_sky.descripti: 为圈子里的人注入飞行的优雅。
ritual.warlockery.manifestation.title: 显现仪式
ritual.warlockery.manifestation.descript: 灵魂行者暂时显现为可见的、可移动的幽灵。
ritual.warlockery.natures_power.title: 自然之力仪式
ritual.warlockery.natures_power.descript: 修复相容的土壤和受损的植被，然后迫使该地区自然生长。
ritual.warlockery.necrostone.title: 死灵仪式：死灵石
ritual.warlockery.necrostone.description: 在夜空下创造一块死灵石。
ritual.warlockery.part_earth.title: 破碎大地仪式
ritual.warlockery.part_earth.description: 在施法者面向的方向上穿过相容的自然地面撕开一条深深的裂缝。
ritual.warlockery.prior_incarnation.desc: 召唤目标玩家在圆圈周围的恢复性回声。
ritual.warlockery.rain_of_toads.title: 蟾蜍雨的诅咒
ritual.warlockery.rain_of_toads.descript: 将有毒且安全爆炸的蟾蜍倾泻到仪式区域。
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth.title: 移动地球仪式
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth.descriptio: 从圆圈中升起一根实心柱。
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth_small.desc: 从小型粉笔圈升起紧密的石柱。
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth_large.desc: 从大型粉笔圈升起宽广高耸的石柱。
ritual.warlockery.recharge_infusion.desc: 为站在圆圈中的女巫恢复魔法储存的魔法。
ritual.warlockery.sanctity.title: 神圣仪式
ritual.warlockery.sanctity.description: 保护圈内的生物免受敌对攻击。
ritual.warlockery.spectral_stone.title: 死灵仪式：幽灵石
ritual.warlockery.storm.title: 天空之怒的仪式
ritual.warlockery.storm.description: 召唤猛烈的雷暴，用闪电攻击魔法连结的或最近的目标。
ritual.warlockery.storm_large.title: 高级天空之怒仪式
ritual.warlockery.storm_large.descriptio: 世界各地将迎来一场持续的雷雨。
ritual.warlockery.storm_portable.title: 便携式天空之怒仪式
ritual.warlockery.storm_portable.descrip: 从圆圈护身符中召唤集中雷暴。
ritual.warlockery.summon_banshee.title: 召唤仪式：女妖
ritual.warlockery.summon_cat_familiar.de: 召唤一只猫为魔宠，可以透过魔法连结为持久的魔法伙伴。
ritual.warlockery.summon_circle_mage.des: 召唤可以透过魔宠和集会祭品招募的法环法师。
ritual.warlockery.blood_audience.title: 血之谒见
ritual.warlockery.blood_audience.descrip: 把没结婚的娜米带到海底神殿最底下，先把远古守卫者全清了。在满月下转化未婚的 Nami，唤醒她血肉中的 Naamah。
ritual.warlockery.summon_demon.title: 召唤仪式：恶魔
ritual.warlockery.summon_demon.descripti: 从地狱召唤一个 Warlockery 恶魔。
ritual.warlockery.summon_familiar.title: 召唤仪式：熟悉
ritual.warlockery.summon_familiar.descri: 召唤一只熟悉的猫来帮助女巫。
ritual.warlockery.summon_forgewarden.des: 召唤一位做好战斗备好的锻造守卫，为附近的狗头人提供力量。
ritual.warlockery.summon_imp.title: 召唤仪式：小鬼
ritual.warlockery.summon_imp.description: 召唤一个可以透过地狱契约神奇连结的火焰小鬼。
ritual.warlockery.summon_lost_soul.title: 召唤仪式：失落的灵魂
ritual.warlockery.summon_lost_soul.descr: 将迷失的灵魂吸引到世界中，以便它可以与精神容器神奇地连接起来。
ritual.warlockery.summon_parasytic_louse: 召唤一只寄生虱子，它可以捕捉并重新导向药水效果。
ritual.warlockery.summon_poltergeist.des: 召唤更大的魔法仪式连结所需的恶作剧鬼。
ritual.warlockery.summon_reflection.desc: 释放被魔法注入的镜子中的敌对回声阴影。
ritual.warlockery.summon_spectre.title: 召唤仪式：幽灵
ritual.warlockery.summon_spectre.descrip: 将幽灵穿过面纱引入仪式圈。
ritual.warlockery.summon_stonebroker.des: 召唤全副武装的石商守护神进行战斗、崇拜和狗头人祝福。
ritual.warlockery.summon_storm_simian.de: 塑造一只受风暴影响的飞行魔宠，可以前往魔法连接的路石。
ritual.warlockery.summon_thorned_pursuer: 在基点处消耗四束沾满血的柳条来召唤荆棘追击者。
ritual.warlockery.summon_witch.title: 召唤仪式：女巫
ritual.warlockery.summon_witch.descripti: 将女巫召唤到备齐的圆圈中心。
ritual.warlockery.summon_wither.title: 召唤仪式：枯萎
ritual.warlockery.summon_wither.descript: 召唤凋灵；开始前先清除内圈。
ritual.warlockery.teleport_entity.title: 换位仪式：生物
ritual.warlockery.teleport_entity.descri: 召唤由魔法连结的魔法连结印记辨识的生物或玩家。
ritual.warlockery.teleport_waystone.desc: 将施法者传送到该次元中一个透过魔法连结的路石。
ritual.warlockery.transpose_ore.title: 换位仪式：矿石
ritual.warlockery.transpose_ore.descript: 从下面的岩石中提取矿石并将其沉积在圆圈处。
ritual.warlockery.volcano.title: 大地之怒仪式
ritual.warlockery.volcano.description: 将附近的地下火山流体池吸入封闭的玄武岩喷口。
message.warlockery.hunter_armor.hex_bloc: 你的猎人盔甲可以抵御诅咒。

manual.warlockery.biome.entry: %s 是陌生土地的精灵。前往那里观察方块、生物与天气，再把它绑进生态域之书，供季节转移仪式用。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.green_land: %s 有树木、草、花朵或肥沃土壤。术士可在此寻找木材、药草、动物与温和的自然魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.waters_and: %s 有河流、海水、沼泽或海岸。术士可在此寻找鱼、黏土、水生植物与水之魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.cold_lands: %s 有雪、冰、高山岩石或寒地树木。术士可在此寻找寒霜材料、山石、山羊与冰冷魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.dry_and_wi: %s 有沙、红色岩石、相思木或强风。术士可在此寻找旱地植物、陶土、黄金与天气魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.caves_and_: %s 有深层岩石、洞穴植物、蘑菇、伏聆或诡异虚空。术士可在此寻找稀有矿物、孢子、回音与隐藏魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.nether_bio: %s 是炎热危险的地狱土地，有火焰、奇异真菌或受灵魂侵染的地面。术士可在此寻找炼狱材料与火焰魔法。
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.end_biomes: %s 是孤寂的终界土地，有终界石、歌莱果与距离之力。术士可在此寻找终界材料与旅行魔法。

manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sca:
Use the Scarecrow binding rite for its exact chalk diagram, ingredients, power, and spirit combinations. A single spectral creature is not enough: bring one complete group listed by the rite.

After casting, collect the bound Scarecrow above the heart. Place it and use an empty hand to read its state.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_tre: 特伦特雕像是向森林做出的木制承诺。将其放在坚实的地面上并呈现一棵树苗、花朵或种子。消耗掉有效的祭品后，耳鼻喉科就会在雕像上方苏醒，雕像的形状由它所在的土地塑造而成。
manual.warlockery.immortal.nami.title: 潮水之前的娜米
manual.warlockery.immortal.nami: 趁 Nami 还是人类时找到她。未婚的 Nami 可以接受婚戒并换上新名字。婚约会永久保护她，让血之觐见无法改造她。只有未婚的 Nami 才能变成 Naamah，Naamah 永远不能结婚。
manual.warlockery.immortal.blood_audienc:
Bring an unmarried Nami to an Ocean Monument and defeat its Elder Guardians first. Use the Blood Audience ritual entry for the current chalk diagram, offerings, full-moon condition, and power requirement.

The rite transforms an unmarried Nami into Naamah. A married Nami is permanently protected and cannot transform. Naamah cannot marry and is hostile when summoned.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dre: Hang this pale weave near a bed. A full sleep grants regeneration unless an unwarded nightmare weave corrupts it into poison.
This green weave restores hunger and saturation after a full sleep. Intensity strengthens it; nightmares invert it.
This blue weave grants Speed after sleep. Intensity sharpens the boon; nightmares answer with Slowness and Weakness.
This magenta weave strengthens helpful neighboring patterns and grants Night Vision when nearest to the bed.
This silver-gray weave grants Haste after sleep. Intensity hones it; nightmares bring Mining Fatigue and Weakness.
This black weave corrupts nearby blessings. Protective dream plants catch its malice and return Absorption instead.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_all: 诱人的头骨可以呼叫十六个街区外的易受影响的生物。将其放置在路径安全的地方，使用兼容的激活焦点将其唤醒或使其安静，然后空手检查它。当它活跃时，它会释放灵魂微粒并不断地将有效生物吸引到它的下巴上。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sta: 女神雕像是一座净化魔法的雕像。当你背负着活跃的六角形时使用它，它会消除你身上的敌对束缚。如果没有得到十六进制的答复，雕像就会报告没有什么需要清理的，并为以后的恳求者做好准备。
在放置之前将崇拜雕像与活体目标绑定。有效的金币或妖精的赞助人会在该绑定目标上召唤幸运 II 和急速 I 两分钟。空手的使用表明了雕像所承载的同情心。
破碎诅咒雕像是一个直接清洁的附魔雕像。携带一个或多个六角形时触摸它，每个活动的六角形都会被切断。它不消耗任何供养，但当不存在恶缘时，它就没有任何作用。
封闭召唤雕像可保护某个场所免受循环作业的影响。空手使用它来唤醒或安静其守卫。活跃的雕像会抑制附近的仪式，因此请将其远离您自己的粉笔，除非您打算阻止其范围内的所有工作。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dol: 娃娃架仅接受玩偶和交感神经血管。它保持自己的块处于唤醒状态，允许存储的绑定玩偶从远处回答它们的主人。使用架子屏幕读取其绑定并在娃娃剩余的耐久度耗尽之前将其移除。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.sympatheti: 感应小瓶可从活物、血蔷薇、吸血箱，或沉睡玩家认领的床铺采集印记。名称与微光会确认绑定成功。
manual.warlockery.conjuration.beast_spee: 拿著兽语护符，给动物喜欢的食物，再对牠用护符。你们便能互相理解，绵羊或其他友善动物也许会用礼物交换供品。银舌护符则能和恶魔交谈。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_artich: 水朝鲜蓟喜耕湿地。收获成熟的作物以获取朝鲜蓟，这是一种冷却花园试剂，用于制作魔法药水和利用水和活体生长的制剂。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_bellad: 颠茄是花园的毒害者。它成熟的叶子会进入有害的魔法药水、变异化合物和需要具有有害性质的活草本的仪式。保持种植直至完全生长以获得最佳产量。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_garlic: 大蒜既是作物又是病房。收获它用于烹饪和魔药制作，将其编织成大蒜花环，或将其携带到吸血鬼工作中。当吸血鬼压在适当的大蒜病房时会​​燃烧。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_mandra: 曼德拉草会产生用于仪式、魔法药水和突变的强大根，但成熟的植物会在破碎时苏醒，并以敌对的曼德拉草的形式崛起。博林可以消除危险的收获。成熟的曼德拉草也形成梦根突变的基本根源。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_dreamr: 梦根是通过准备好的曼德拉草突变而诞生的。它的收获滋养了梦想的魔法并产生了球茎。种植球茎以继续作物生长；几个呼吸后松动的灯泡就会苏醒，并寻找最近的生存玩家。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_snowbe: 斯诺贝尔将冬天储存在活茎中。其成熟的收获物可提供冰冷针和其他冷系试剂，用于冷冻魔法药水、防护装备以及无需普通冰即可召唤霜的工作。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wolfsb: 狼毒在狼人被猎杀或治愈的地方种植。它的收获属于狼人仪式、猎人准备和旨在困扰体内野兽的魔法药剂。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wormwo: 艾草是通往精神的苦桥。保留药草和种子，用于幽灵魔法药水、熏蒸以及与死者或面纱有关的仪式。成熟的床可以为这些工作消耗提供可靠的供应。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_ember_: 余烬苔藓在兼容的地面上缓慢传播，并散发出储存的热量。在没有保护的情况下穿过它的生物可能会被点燃。将其用作警告地毯、炽热试剂或温暖的神秘光源。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_glint_: 闪光杂草是一种明亮、自蔓延的草本植物，在兼容的土地上茁壮成长。它提供强烈的自然光，无需火焰，适用于任何需要发光的生活生长的地方。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_spanis: 西班牙苔藓是悬挂式而非立式。让它从合适的支撑物上拖下来，并小心地收获它，用于编织、悬挂魅力和需要接触潮湿空气的柔软植物纤维的食谱。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_somnia: 睡眠棉收集睡眠的残留物。在夜间或醒着的噩梦中，它会产生不安的棉花，这种纤维用于梦境束缚线和防护织物。在普通白天，它保持休眠状态。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_leapin: 跳跃的百合花喜欢水花园。刷树叶的生物会获得短暂的速度祝福和更强的跳跃能力。将它们种植在安全的十字路口，或者收获它们用于制作运动对齐的药水。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_blood_: 血玫瑰回应了暴力和血腥工艺。将它种植在远离安静的花坛的地方，并保留它的花瓣用于吸血鬼工作、血液试剂和仪式，而活生生的花朵必须记住伤害。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_brambl: 布兰布尔是一个带刺的生命屏障。它减缓了粗心的路径，提供了荆棘排列的成分，并且适合防御性花园，普通的栅栏不会带来神奇的同情心。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_void_b: 虚空荆棘抓住肉体并静止附近的仪式力量。种植它可以阻止敌对圈子或保护门槛，但在开始仪式之前，请将其放置在远离自己的粉笔的地方。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_grassp: 握草藤将一件提供的物品固定在其叶子上方，并在再次使用时将其归还。四个对角握草藤作为高级活体突变的成分基座，包括创建蟾蜍和梦根的仪式。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_pitgra: 坑草用长满青草的表面伪装成准备好的坑地。在隐蔽的花园陷阱和防御路径中使用它，普通的草会暴露下面的空洞。
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_critte: 小动物圈套捕获一个兼容的小生物，该生物进入其中并在块移动时保留该生物。填充史莱姆陷阱是蟾蜍突变中的活性成分；空手释放储存的生物。
message.warlockery.magic.not_attuned: 秘术焦点仍在沉睡。呼唤力量前，先饮用灌注药剂搞定调和。
manual.warlockery.immortal.vampire_level: 等级 1：鲜血谒见
试炼：在满月下，以十二道仪式粉笔、十六道炼狱粉笔、八道帷幕粉笔、死灵之石、幸运之滴、凋零玫瑰、幽灵之泪与 5,000 祭坛力量举行 Naamah 谒见。击败 Naamah，再把她的女王之血交给另一位 Naamah。能力：吸血与血液感知。血量上限：750。
等级 2：满溢之杯
试炼：从活物、温血或鲜血坩埚补满 750 血量。能力：定身凝视与夜视。新上限：1,000。
等级 3：五次深饮
试炼：从五名不同村民身上各饮去超过一半的血。能力：徒手攻击带有超自然击退。血量上限：1,250。
等级 4：四夜不眠
试炼：把三张撕破的页面装回本书并随身携带，连续度过四个不眠之夜。能力：消耗鲜血的吸血鬼疾速。血量上限：1,500。
等级 5：虚假太阳
试炼：装回第四张撕破的页面，并在夜间以十枚充能太阳手榴弹灼烧自己。能力：阳光抗性只能减轻，不能消除白昼诅咒。血量上限：1,750。
等级 6：烈焰之心
试炼：装回第五张撕破的页面并击杀二十只烈焰使者。能力：碎石可徒手破坏普通岩石。血量上限：2,000。
等级 7：女王的罂粟
试炼：装回第六张撕破的页面，再次谒见并击败 Naamah，然后献上一朵罂粟。能力：只要仍有鲜血，蝙蝠群形态便可飞行。血量上限：2,250。
等级 8：四座钟塔
试炼：装回第七张撕破的页面，以蝙蝠群形态不落地造访四座不同村庄。能力：催眠能短暂扭曲村民的意志。血量上限：2,500。
等级 9：精量收获
试炼：装回第八张撕破的页面，把五名不同村民拘束在牢笼、船或矿车中，在不杀死他们的前提下各吸至约半血。能力：创造吸血鬼。血量上限：3,250。
等级 10：长夜之主
试炼：装回全部九张撕破的页面。催眠一名村民并完全吸干其血，交给他盛有创造者鲜血的高脚杯，并在附近放置棺材，成功令其转化。能力：唤风暴、瞬移、召蝙蝠与僵尸敬畏。血量上限：3,500。
manual.warlockery.circles.werewolf_level: 等级 1：初月
试炼：在满月下接受狼人妖术。起初满月会强迫你化为狼形。能力：超自然韧性，并免疫一般毒素与疾病。
等级 2：镀金缰绳
试炼：满月时在狼之祭坛献上三块金锭。能力：月之护符可控制变身；狼形猎杀的绵羊会提供下次试炼所需羊肉。
等级 3：牧羊人的清算
试炼：以狼形猎羊，再于狼之祭坛献上三十块生羊肉。能力：利爪可瞬间挖掘泥土与沙，有时会翻出骨头。
等级 4：赤红盛宴
试炼：在狼之祭坛献上十条狗舌。能力：野兽形态猎杀后，盛宴会恢复生命、饥饿与饱和度。
等级 5：猎杀猎人
试炼：用变身后的利爪亲手杀死荆棘追猎者。能力：猎号，以及透过月之护符化为直立狼人。
等级 6：奔袭利爪
试炼：以狼形或狼人形态，在空中给予致命一击并杀死十只敌对生物，然后返回狼之祭坛。能力：奔袭利爪会把跳跃攻击化为粉碎冲锋。
等级 7：十六回声
试炼：在十六个不同区域嚎叫。能力：集中嚎叫能震晕附近敌人。
等级 8：召集狼群
试炼：以狼形结交六只不同的野狼。能力：狼群嚎叫能召唤忠诚狼只协助战斗。
等级 9：撕裂地狱
试炼：在地狱变身并杀死三十只僵尸化猪布林。能力：撕裂爪能穿透并磨损盔甲。
等级 10：诅咒之咬
试炼：变身时杀死一名村民或同意的盟友玩家。能力：近乎致命的一咬可能把狼人诅咒传给毫无防护的凡人。

用变形后的爪子击败荆棘追击者。

Yellow chalk is called Golden Chalk in the inventory and JEI. Combine 1 Gypsum with 1 Yellow Dye in any crafting arrangement to make 1 Golden Chalk with 64 uses.

Getting Gypsum
1. Craft Soft Clay Jars from clay balls, then fire them in a furnace to make Clay Jars.
2. Feed a log and a Clay Jar into a fueled Alchemical Oven. Collect the Wood Ash and Foul Fume.
3. Craft Wood Ash into Quicklime.
4. Put Foul Fume, Quicklime, and a Clay Jar into a Distillery within range of an active altar. This working takes 40 seconds and draws 480 total altar power gradually. Collect the Gypsum alongside Oil of Vitriol and a Slimeball.

The Chalk chapter contains every chalk recipe, the jars and machines, and the Wood Ash, Foul Fume, and Gypsum workings. The Distilling book also lists the Gypsum working under Distilling Oil of Vitriol. In JEI, look up recipes for Gypsum or uses for Foul Fume.

manual.warlockery.onboarding.first_steps:
First workshop
If you need your first Belladonna, start with the Herbology book and its Warlock farming instructions. Its recipe uses only ordinary flowers, black dye, a book, and a feather.

1. Craft the Alchemical Oven and Clay Jars using the Fume Workshop recipes. Add fuel to the oven.
2. Process a Birch Sapling with a Clay Jar to collect Breath of the Goddess.
3. Use a breath to craft the Distilling book. Make a Distillery, then follow that book to build an altar and distill your first ingredients.
4. Make Whiff of Magic in the Distillery, then craft Circle Magic for chalk and rituals.

Keep your books in your inventory. Blue references open the named section; Back returns to the page you were reading.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.distillery:
Make a Distillery first: place Glass Bottles above, below, left, and right of an Iron Ingot in a crafting table. The next pages show the Distillery and Altar recipes.

Build the altar before loading a powered recipe. Open the Distillery, put each listed ingredient and Clay Jar in an input slot, and leave room for every output. The Distillery uses altar power, not furnace fuel. A recipe starts automatically when its inputs, power, and output space are ready. The progress arrow shows it working.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.altar:
Build the altar
Craft the Altar recipe twice for 6 blocks. Place all six in one flat 2 by 3 rectangle, at the same height, with no extra altar blocks touching it. Right-click with an empty hand to check formation and stored power. Allow a few seconds for the altar to update.

Place a Distillery or another powered machine within 32 blocks horizontally. For a ritual, keep an altar block within 32 blocks horizontally of its golden heart. In both cases the altar must be no more than 4 blocks below or 6 above. Keeping everything on the same level is easiest.

Living plants and trees around the altar increase its capacity and recharge. Power fills over time; capacity is not the same as stored power. Wait until the stored amount meets the recipe or ritual requirement. Machine recipes marked continuous draw the displayed total gradually. An active ritual reserves power, so other workings cannot spend it.

Attach a Ritual Knife to the altar to double its reach: 64 blocks horizontally, with the altar up to 8 blocks below or 12 above the working. The ordinary 32-block range works without a knife.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.cast:
Cast a first ritual
1. Open Rite of Broiling and copy its chalk diagram onto flat ground. Each small grid square is one ground block. Use Ritual Chalk for the white marks and Golden Chalk for the center heart.
2. Drop one Coal or Charcoal and some raw food, such as Raw Beef, near the heart. The coal is an offering; the food is the material to cook. Keep offerings within 6 blocks of the heart.
3. Charge a nearby completed altar to at least 600 power. Hold an Arcane Focus and use it on the golden heart.
4. Select Rite of Broiling. Read every requirement; use the detail arrows or scroll the right panel to read further pages; fix missing items, marks, or power and press Refresh. When ready, press Begin.
5. Leave the pattern intact and wait 5 seconds for the cast. The coal is consumed and the dropped raw food becomes cooked food. Pick up the result.

Use the same sequence for other rites, following their own diagram, ingredients, timing, targets, and conditions. The Ritual Knife is an optional altar attachment. The Arcane Focus opens the ritual selection screen.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.seeds:
Your first seeds
Make a Distillery from 4 Glass Bottles around an Iron Ingot. Put it near an unemployed adult villager so they can become a Warlock. Prepare empty, watered farmland nearby and leave the villager room to reach it. Warlocks plant one randomly chosen starter herb; different Warlocks may plant different herbs. Harvest a mature crop for herbs and seeds, then replant. Villager farming requires mob griefing to be enabled.

For an Arcane Focus, grow Belladonna and Mandrake. You need 2 Belladonna, 1 Mandrake Root, and 2 Sticks. Keep looking for a Warlock planting the herb you need; a Warlock buying seeds is not selling them.

Herbology is your first book: craft it with a flower above and below a Book, Black Dye to its left, and a Feather to its right. After your first Belladonna harvest, craft the Oven book to begin collecting fumes.

Sentinel: 3 Spirits and 3 Spectres.

Provide any altar power listed by that recipe. Close the screen and use Flint and Steel or a Fire Charge on the Brazier to ignite it. Leave the Wood Ash inside while it burns. The working can summon a spirit or affect nearby creatures as described on its recipe page.

Use a Water Bucket or Water Bottle to extinguish it and clear its contents. Check your recipe before lighting: unrelated ingredients can prevent a match.

It needs no fire or furnace fuel. Leave its output slot clear. Recipes start automatically and draw the listed total altar power gradually. Collect the thread, twine, or web when progress finishes.

Craft the Silver Vat using its recipe. Place it directly above a lit Campfire or Magma Block for ingredient processing. Put an Iron Ingot and Oil of Vitriol into its input slots; after 20 seconds, collect 3 Silver Dust from its outputs. This working needs no altar power.

The vat can also collect silver deposits from completed smelting cycles in a furnace directly beside it. This is a separate passive source: keep output space free and allow the neighboring furnace to finish actual smelting cycles.

jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_summon_ban: Summons Banshees when the burn finishes.
jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_summon_pol: Summons Poltergeists when the burn finishes.
jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_graveyard_: Spreads visible graveyard mist while burning.
jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_anguish_of: Grants Strength to living creatures within 4 blocks while burning.
jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_fortificat: Grants Resistance to living creatures within 4 blocks while burning.
jei.warlockery.effect.brazier_deathly_ve: Grants Invisibility to living creatures within 6 blocks while burning.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.site: Before casting, drop item offerings within 6 blocks of the golden heart. The checklist uses dropped items, not items still in your inventory. Keep the heart, required chalk and altar intact throughout the cast, and remain in the same dimension. Circle Magic cannot be cast in the Spirit World. If the checklist reports an inhibitor, remove nearby active Occluded Summons Statues or Void Bramble, then Refresh. Only one rite can cast at a heart at a time.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.summon_en: Clear a 7 by 7 space centered on the heart for the summoned creature. The four block layers immediately above the heart must contain no solid blocks or block entities. Keep this space clear until casting finishes; the chalk and floor below it may remain.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.sample: To prepare a sympathetic target, use a Sympathetic Vial on the intended living creature or player. You can also use it on an online player's claimed respawn bed. Check the vial's bound name, then drop it near the heart. Remove other bound samples so the rite does not select a different target.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.prior_inc: Bind the vial to the player whose belongings you want to recover. That player must have returned after death and stand within %1$s blocks of the heart. Build the circle in the same dimension as their recorded death, within 16 blocks of that death location. Some belongings from that recorded death must still exist; already collected or destroyed items cannot be recreated. Recovered belongings appear above the heart.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.manifest: Bind the vial to a player and keep that player sleeping in a bed within %1$s blocks of the heart in this dimension. The sleeper must not already be manifested. Keep them asleep through the cast. The rite creates their temporary manifestation; it does not summon an unbound sleeping player.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.cleanse: The bound target must stand within %1$s blocks of the heart in this dimension and have this particular hex active. A different hex does not satisfy the requirement. Check the vial's target and the named curse before casting.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.call_fami: You must already have a living familiar bound to you. Its dimension must be loaded so the rite can find it. Summoning a creature alone does not establish this bond; use the familiar binding rite first.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.owned_fam: The caster must already have a living, bound familiar in a loaded dimension. An unbound summoned creature does not satisfy this condition.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.bind_item: Drop a prepared sympathetic sample near the heart as well as the listed materials. The resulting item inherits that sample's target. An empty, unbound vial cannot supply a target.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.bind_fami: Bring an eligible living familiar, ordinary Cat, or ordinary Frog within %1$s blocks of the heart. Remove its lead and any riders, and take it out of a boat or other vehicle. An ordinary Cat must be untamed or owned by the caster. The nearest eligible creature is selected; keep other candidates away. A Cat becomes a familiar cat, a Frog becomes a toad, and an existing familiar is bound in place.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.bind_spec: Drop a Spectral Stone with room remaining near the heart and bring living spectral creatures within %1$s blocks. A stone holds up to 3 creatures of one species; a partly filled stone accepts only that same species. Use a single stone and compatible species to make the result predictable. Captured creatures disappear into the stone; pick the stone up afterward.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.marriage: The caster and intended partner must both be unmarried. Arrange the ceremony with your intended partner before casting. A dropped bound sample selects its player or Nami first; otherwise the nearest other player is selected before an unmarried Nami. Keep only your intended partner near the circle and remove unintended bound samples. A Nami marriage also needs an available demon name. The rite does not show a separate acceptance prompt to the partner.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.divorce: The caster must have an existing marriage. This rite ends that marriage; it does not choose a spouse from nearby players. The former partner is notified when available. Keep the listed Wedding Ring offering near the heart.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.earths_wr: Choose ground above at least 4 volcanic fluid source blocks, such as Lava sources. Flowing fluid does not count. The rite searches loaded ground up to 48 blocks below the heart and %2$s blocks horizontally. The sources must be below the heart, not at its height. The vent forms near the closest qualifying source.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.climate_s: Drop a Book of Biomes or Biome Note that has already recorded the desired biome near the heart. An unrecorded book does not choose a destination biome. A Seer Stone together with at least 5 nearby participants empowers the change; optional Nether Stars increase its reach. Read the climate reach notes for the amounts consumed and area affected.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.transform: Perform this rite inside an Ocean Monument after defeating its Elder Guardians. Bring an unmarried Nami within %1$s blocks of the heart. A married Nami cannot transform. Keep the required moon and site conditions through the cast; the resulting Naamah is hostile.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.bind_ways: Drop an unbound Waystone near the heart. The rite records this heart's position and dimension in the stone. Pick it up after the cast; the destination is this circle, not the caster's bed.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.copy_ways: Drop both a recorded Bound Waystone and an unbound Waystone near the heart. The unbound stone receives the source stone's destination. Use only one source destination at a time, and pick up both stones afterward.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.teleport_: Drop a Bound Waystone carrying a recorded destination near the heart. The caster travels to that destination. Travel to a different dimension also requires Otherwhere. Protective fetish effects can prevent the teleport. An unrecorded stone cannot take you anywhere.

Bind the sample to the intended living target and bring that target within %1$s blocks of the heart in this dimension. The rite moves that target to the heart; it cannot pull an arbitrary distant creature into the circle. A protective fetish effect can prevent the teleport.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.bind_circ: Drop an empty Circle Talisman within 6 blocks of the heart. After the cast it stores the prepared circle and removes the captured chalk pattern from the ground. Pick up the filled talisman. A talisman already carrying a circle is not an empty container.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.hex: Use a bound sympathetic sample to select an intended target where the rite permits one, and keep that target within %1$s blocks of the heart. Without a usable bound target, effects may select nearby creatures instead. Keep unintended targets outside the working area. Protective fetish effects may block hostile magic.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.infusion_: A dropped sample bound to a player directs the infusion or recharge to that player. Without such a sample, players within %1$s blocks are affected. Remove unintended bound samples and have the intended recipients ready before casting.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.glyph_tra: Prepare a complete ring of an accepted source glyph around a golden heart. Drop only the chalk type named by the chosen transformation: 1 piece selects the small ring, 2 the medium ring, and 3 the large ring. Mixed transformation chalk types or any other count are rejected. The chalk pieces are consumed when casting begins.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.huntsman: The four bloodied Wicker Bundles are a separate structure requirement, not dropped offerings. Keep the completed structure in place through casting. The detailed bundle preparation instructions in this entry show its exact positions.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.fetish: The living spirit group is checked in addition to the listed item offerings. Keep the complete chosen group within %1$s blocks of the heart until completion. The mode and consumed spirit combinations are listed in this entry.
manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.cook: Keep the raw food to be cooked as dropped items within %1$s blocks of the heart until completion. The raw food is a target of the completed rite, separate from its consumed Coal or Charcoal offering.
manual.warlockery.machine_recipe.ignite: Close the screen and use Flint and Steel or a Fire Charge on the Brazier to ignite it.
screen.warlockery.ritual.casting_help: A rite is casting at this circle. Its ingredients and altar power are already reserved. Casting continues while this screen is open or closed. Use Stop to cancel.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.biomen:
Hold a Blank Biome Note and use it on an ordinary block to record the biome at that block. The note gains a biome name and description without being consumed. Using it on another block replaces its record. Using it in the air does not record anything.

Craft the standalone note from paper, an ink sac and a compass using the crafting page in this chapter. As another recording tool, craft a Book of Biomes from a book, a sapling, black dye, a feather and stone. Hold that book, crouch and use it on a block to record the biome; ordinary use opens the book. A recorded Book of Biomes or Extended Edition serves as a biome record for the climate-changing rite, just like a recorded note. Read the rite's own page before preparing its circle and offerings.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.device_all:
Craft an Alluring Skull from one bone, two Graveyard Dust, a Skeleton Skull and a Necromantic Stone, then place it where creatures can reach it. Use a Necromantic Stone on the placed skull to switch its lure on or off; the stone is not consumed. Use the skull with an empty hand to check its state.

While active, it calls Zombies, Skeletons, Phantoms, the Wither, spectral creatures and the other susceptible undead listed by the game from within 16 blocks, refreshing their path toward the skull once each second. It does not summon creatures or force a route through solid obstacles.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.device_bea:
Craft a Bear Trap from seven Iron Ingots and one Redstone Dust, place it, then use it with an empty hand to arm or disarm it. An armed trap springs when a living, non-spectral creature enters it, dealing 6 damage and applying Slowness VI for 3 seconds.

The sprung trap keeps restraining an eligible creature that remains inside it. Use a sprung trap with an empty hand to reset and arm it again. Spectators, Armor Stands and spectral creatures do not trigger it.
manual.warlockery.herbology.device_plant:
Craft a Plant Mine from four Wooden Rods, four Dense Webs and one Redstone Dust. Plant it on suitable soil, then use exactly one supported payload on it: Brew of Blindness or Ink blinds nearby creatures for 12 seconds; Brew of Fertilize, Brew of Grow Flowers, Brew of Grow Sapling or Brew of Sprouting accelerates plants and spreads moss; Brew of Thorns raises cactus or berry thorns; Brew of Webs lays cobwebs and gives Slowness III for 5 seconds.

Loading consumes one payload. The first eligible living creature to enter an armed mine triggers its area effect and destroys the mine. An empty hand reports whether it is armed; a second payload cannot replace the first.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.device_wic:
Craft a Wicker Bundle from five Wooden Rods and four Wool blocks, then place it and use one blood source on it. Raw meat, Warm Blood or a supported blood goblet is consumed and permanently marks that bundle as bloodied. Breaking a bloodied bundle preserves the mark when it is placed again.

The Rite of Summon Thorned Pursuer needs four bloodied bundles at the chalk heart's height, exactly two blocks north, south, east and west. Keep them placed through the cast; a successful rite consumes all four bundles. Use a bundle with an empty hand to check whether it is ready.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.device_dem:
A player-killed Demon has a 25% base chance to drop a Demon Heart, improved by Looting; a player-killed Abyssal Regent drops one or two before Looting. Place the heart as a block, empty your hand, and use it to consume the placed heart.

Consumption destroys the block, ignites you for 8 seconds, and grants Hunger II, Speed III, Health Boost I, Strength III, Nausea I, Regeneration II and Fire Resistance I for 2 minutes. The Fire Resistance protects against the ignition, but the Hunger and Nausea are part of the bargain. Demon Hearts are also reagents, so do not place and consume one meant for a rite or machine.
manual.warlockery.symbology.device_cryst:
Create a Crystal Ball with the nighttime Rite of Infusion: Crystal Ball: supply 2,000 power, twelve Ritual Glyphs, twelve Veil Glyphs, a Quartz Sphere, Hint of Rebirth and one Happenstance Oil. Place the result, then use another Happenstance Oil on it for a weather, moon, night or day prediction and Luck I for 60 seconds; that oil is consumed.

Use a bound Waystone on the ball to read its recorded dimension and coordinates without consuming it. At night, sneak-use Happenstance Oil to call a Hedge Crone four blocks in front of you; this consumes the oil and fails during daytime or while another Hedge Crone is within 32 blocks.
manual.warlockery.fumes.device_sun_colle:
Place a Sun Collector under open sky with a Daylight Detector touching any face. From dawn through noon, it samples that detector once each second and stores the highest signal from 1 to 15. Shade or an unpowered detector clears the charge during that charging window; stored charge remains after noon.

Under open sky, hold Quartz Spheres and use them on a charged collector to turn the entire held stack into Sun Grenades carrying the stored strength. This empties the collector. An empty-hand use reports that a chargeable item is required. The crafting page in this chapter makes the collector from three colorless glass blocks, four copper ingots, a Daylight Detector and redstone dust. The Quartz Sphere crafting page here makes its charging material from quartz gems, quartz blocks and glass.
manual.warlockery.herbology.device_void_:
Plant Void Bramble on suitable soil. Placement records its owner, preventing other Survival players from mining it normally. Any living creature that enters receives Weakness I and Slowness II for 2 seconds and is teleported to a random surface destination up to 500 blocks along each horizontal axis; each creature has a 5-second teleport cooldown. The planter is affected too.

A Void Bramble suppresses ritual magic within 32 blocks, including your own circle, so measure the distance before casting. Use it with an empty hand to confirm that it is active. Craft it from sweet berries, Ender Dew and Refined Evil using the crafting page here. Distilling's recipe chapter explains making both reagents.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.device_dre: Dream Weaver: Configure and Use: Use

Craft the Restoration weave from three Fanciful Thread, one Wooden Rod and one Mellifluous Hunger. The five shapeless variants combine that base weave with a Golden Carrot, Rabbit's Foot, Glowstone Dust, Iron Ingot or Fermented Spider Eye. After placing any Dream Weaver, use an Arcane Focus on it to cycle Restoration, Fasting, Fleet Foot, Intensity, Iron Arm and Nightmares; the focus is not consumed. An empty hand reports the selected mode.

Place the desired weave within 8 blocks of your bed and complete at least 5 seconds of normal sleep before waking. Restoration grants Regeneration II; Fasting feeds you; Fleet Foot grants Speed II; Intensity grants Night Vision; and Iron Arm grants Haste II. Intensity weaves strengthen some nearby beneficial rewards. An unprotected Nightmare weave corrupts nearby rewards and gives harmful effects; Wispy Cotton or Spirit fluid within four blocks horizontally and two blocks vertically of the bed provides dream protection, causing a protected Nightmare weave to grant Absorption II instead.
manual.warlockery.symbology.divinerwater:
Hold the Water Diviner and use it on a ground block. It checks that exact vertical column, starting at the clicked block and searching down to the bottom of the world. Chat reports the depth of the first water it finds, or that there is none below.

Each search spends one durability, including an unsuccessful search; a new diviner has 128 uses. It does not search sideways, dig a shaft or collect the water. See the Water Diviner crafting page in this chapter.
manual.warlockery.symbology.divinerlava:
Hold the Lava Diviner and use it on a ground block. It checks that exact vertical column, starting at the clicked block and searching down to the bottom of the world. Chat reports the depth of the first lava it finds, or that there is none below.

Each search spends one durability, including an unsuccessful search; a new diviner has 128 uses. It does not search sideways, dig a shaft or collect the lava. See the Lava Diviner crafting page in this chapter. Approach a discovered lava pocket with fire protection and a safe escape route.
manual.warlockery.symbology.playercompas:
Hold the Player Compass and use it directly on another player to bind it to that person. The binding names the player in the compass tooltip. A creature or a Sympathetic Vial does not substitute for this interaction.

Keep the compass in your inventory to refresh the bound player's position while that player is available on the server. Use the needle in the same dimension as the target; it cannot point through another dimension. If the player is unavailable, the last recorded position can be stale. Using it on another player replaces the binding without consuming the compass.

Make the Player Compass in a powered Warlock's Cauldron. This chapter includes its machine recipe; The Warlock's Cauldron Codex explains cauldron preparation and operation.
manual.warlockery.symbology.shelfcompass:
Place a Doll Shelf at the location you want to remember. Hold the Doll Shelf Compass, crouch and use it on that shelf so the shelf's inventory does not open instead. The confirmation message means that exact shelf position and dimension have been recorded.

Use the compass in the same dimension to find that position again. It does not automatically choose the nearest shelf or follow a shelf that has been moved. Bind it to a new shelf with the same interaction to replace the destination. Binding does not consume the compass.

See its crafting page here. Conjuration and Fetishes, under Bound Fetishes, explains the Doll Shelf and the dolls it can protect.
manual.warlockery.codex.brewbag.title: Brew Bag: Use
manual.warlockery.codex.brewbag:
Open your inventory and pick up the Brew Bag with a normal click. Click a brew stack while holding the bag on the cursor to store it, then click an empty slot to put the bag down. To retrieve a stored brew, hold the bag on the cursor and right-click an empty inventory slot.

Put the loaded bag in your hand, aim and use it to throw one selected brew. If no brew is selected, it uses the first stored brew. The thrown brew keeps its normal effects and credits you as its thrower; the reusable bag remains. It fires only throwable brews. A stored drink-only brew cannot be launched, and an empty bag cannot fire. Other materials do not belong in this bag.

The adjacent crafting page makes one bag from Impregnated Leather and Fanciful Thread. Distilling, under Spinning and Silver, explains the spinning wheel used to prepare the thread.
manual.warlockery.symbology.mirror.title: Mirror: Use
manual.warlockery.symbology.mirror:
The handheld Mirror is made by the Rite of Infusion: Mirror. Read that rite in Brews and Infusions and charge the altar for the displayed requirements. The rite consumes a placed-mirror item as an offering, so keep or craft another full Mirror block for the destination you want to visit.

Place that full Mirror block at your destination. Hold the handheld Mirror and use it on the block to record its reflection. Then, from elsewhere, hold the handheld Mirror and use it in the air to return. Leave a clear landing space above the placed mirror before recording it.

Each successful return spends one durability from the handheld Mirror's 128 uses. An unbound mirror cannot travel, and a failed return does not spend durability. The destination can be in another available dimension; it does not require an Otherwhere infusion or personal reserve. This chapter includes the full Mirror block recipe and the infusion rite.
manual.warlockery.symbology.ingredient_s:
Hold the Seer Stone and use it in the air to read your supernatural form, supernatural reserve, active infusions and total infusion reserve in chat. This basic reading consumes nothing. With Happenstance Oil in your other hand, the same use also gives one omen: rain or thunder takes priority, followed by a full moon at night, then ordinary night or day; one oil is consumed.

Use the stone on a Golden Chalk center to gather your recruited Circle Mages around it. Only your living mages that are currently present in loaded parts of the server can answer; a distant unloaded mage will not be brought in. This call does not consume the stone or Happenstance Oil and needs no altar charge. Conjuration and Fetishes explains recruiting a coven.

Make the stone with the Rite of Infusion: Seer Stone in Brews and Infusions; the rite is also indexed in this chapter. Consult its displayed offerings, chalk and power before casting.
manual.warlockery.symbology.ruby_slipper:
First use a bed, or a valid charged Respawn Anchor in its proper dimension, to set your home spawn. Hold the Ruby Slippers in your hand and use them in the air to return to your respawn destination. Merely wearing them does not activate homeward travel.

A successful return starts a five-minute cooldown. During that time you cannot use any Ruby Slippers again. The slippers are reusable and are not consumed. The game resolves your normal respawn destination, so a missing or obstructed home can send you to world spawn instead; check that your home is still usable before relying on it.

The crafting page in this chapter combines footwear, red dye, an ender pearl and Whiff of Magic. Distilling explains how to prepare the Whiff of Magic.
manual.warlockery.distilling.ingredient_:
Hold an Attuned Stone and use it on an altar to withdraw up to 250 available altar power. Crouch and use it to return up to 250 power. The stone holds at most 2,000; an empty source or full destination prevents transfer. Power reserved for a rite already casting cannot be withdrawn. Successful transfers report the stone's remaining charge.

An ordinary stone starts empty. Charging it does not change its item type. The crafting page here makes the empty stone; the Rite of Charging, also indexed here and in Circle Magic under Binding Rites, makes the charged variant.

Either variant can answer the Listening Ring. Drop it into the empty center of a hollow three-by-three ring of eight Ritual Chalk marks, without a Golden Chalk center. Leave it there for three seconds and stay within 32 blocks. The ring reports a village in the Overworld or a Nether fortress in the Nether, searching up to 2,048 blocks. It consumes neither the stone nor its power and needs no altar. Pick up and drop the stone again to repeat; other dimensions do not answer.

This variant starts with 2,000 altar power. Crouch and use it on an altar to deposit up to 250 power per use. Normal use withdraws up to 250 available altar power back into the stone. Transfer stops when the source is empty or the destination is full; power promised to a casting rite remains reserved. Emptying the stone does not change its item type.

Make this variant with the Rite of Charging, indexed here and in Circle Magic under Binding Rites. A stone with any stored power also satisfies the powered-stone requirement of prepared living mutations in Herbology. Those mutations consume the offered stone itself.

Either stone variant can answer the Listening Ring. Drop it into the empty center of eight Ritual Chalk marks around a three-by-three square, without a Golden Chalk center, and wait three seconds. In the Overworld it seeks a village; in the Nether it seeks a fortress. Remain within 32 blocks to hear the result. The search consumes no stone or stored power and needs no altar; pick it up and drop it again to repeat.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.ingredient: Bone Needle: Use

Bind a Hexing Doll to the intended creature, place that doll in your offhand, and use a Bone Needle from your main hand. A successful strike consumes one needle and deals one point of magic damage to the bound target, subject to its protections.

The target must be another living entity that the server can currently resolve. A missing doll, missing binding, unavailable target, protective fetish or resisted strike prevents consumption. This is a remote attack: you do not need to aim at the victim.

The adjacent crafting page makes eight needles from bone and flint. Read Hexing Doll in this book's Sympathetic Dolls chapter to prepare the binding.
Creeper Heart: Use

Use a Creeper Heart directly on a Bramble Colossus whose base maximum health is below 100. One heart raises that maximum to 100 and fully heals it. Ownership is not required. A colossus already at that maximum receives no further upgrade.

You can also hold use to eat the heart, even when full. Eating consumes the heart and releases an explosion around you that damages nearby entities while leaving blocks intact. Choose the feeding or eating action carefully: feeding the colossus and eating the heart have different results.

Creeper kills made with a Ritual Knife can yield this heart. Read Ritual Knife in Circle Magic for the harvesting knife and its special drops.
Graveyard Dust: Use

Use Graveyard Dust directly on a spectral creature bound to you, such as an owned Spectre, Banshee or Poltergeist. Each successful use consumes one dust, adds up to two points to its base maximum health, and heals two health points.

The upgrade stops at 50 base maximum health. Unowned creatures, creatures outside the spectral group and creatures already at the cap receive no upgrade and consume no dust. This strengthens an existing bound creature; it does not establish ownership.

The crafting page here combines Spectral Dust, Verdant Catalyst and fertilizer. Prepare and bind your summoned creature before spending the dust.
manual.warlockery.herbology.ingredient_a:
Harvest a mature Water Artichoke for a globe; the Water Artichoke growing page is in this chapter. Hold use to eat the globe when hungry. One globe fills your food bar, but gives Hunger III for three seconds per hunger point restored. For example, restoring twelve points gives 36 seconds of Hunger III.

A level-ten vampire with completely full blood can instead use a globe on a Blood Crucible. This consumes the globe and all stored blood, selects Call Storm and grants five charges. Charging it replaces any stored charges of the other Blood Crucible powers. Observations of an Immortal explains the level and blood requirements; eating the globe does not charge a power.
manual.warlockery.herbology.mutator:
Mine a dirt block with the Mutating Sprig to change it into Mycelium; mine Mycelium to change it back to dirt. With water immediately above the block, mining dirt instead makes clay, and mining clay returns dirt. Each successful transformation costs one durability and replaces the block instead of harvesting it. The sprig has 128 durability; its crafting page is in this chapter.

Use the sprig on a prepared mutation's central cobweb, or the block immediately above or below it, to attempt a living mutation. The cobweb needs water beneath it. Four Grasspers must stand on the diagonal rays, one to three blocks from the center. Missing requirements are reported without spending durability.

To make Toads, provide at least four slime-filled Critter Snares, a nearby cat or ocelot, and Grasspers holding three Mutandis Extremis and one Attuned Stone with stored power. Owls use at least four bat-filled snares and a wolf with the same offerings. Keep hosts and snares within four blocks horizontally of the center.

For Dreamroot, place four mature Mandrakes along the cardinal rays, one to three blocks out. Fill the diagonal Grasspers with two Mutandis Extremis, one Focused Will and one powered Attuned Stone; bring a Creeper and a living Mandrake within four blocks horizontally. Use the sprig to replace the four crops with Dreamroot.

A successful mutation consumes its cobweb, the offered Grassper ingredients and the required living host or hosts, and costs one sprig durability. Toad and Owl mutations empty their snares and create one creature per filled snare. The offered stone is consumed even if it held more power than needed. Distilling, under Portable Altar Power, explains charging the stone.
manual.warlockery.herbology.seedsdreamro:
Use a Dreamroot Bulb on farmland to plant a Dreamroot crop, consuming one bulb. Harvest Dreamroot to recover bulbs and collect additional bulbs from a mature crop. The prepared living mutation described in this book makes the first Dreamroot crops.

Dropping a bulb loose lets it wake into a living Dreamroot after at least three seconds. Each creature consumes one dropped bulb; stacks wake in batches of at most four, and a busy world may delay further waking. This does not tame or bind the creature. Plant bulbs directly when you want to continue the crop.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.ingredient: Rock: Use

Hold a Rock and use it to throw one, consuming the rock. It travels like a snowball. Ordinary targets receive no direct health damage, while a Blaze receives three damage points before any applicable protections. Rocks are expendable projectiles.

The crafting page here turns one cobblestone into four Rocks. Keep them in your hand when you want to throw them; there is no charging step or binding requirement.
manual.warlockery.biomes.biomenote.title: Blank Biome Note: Use
manual.warlockery.biomes.biomenote:
Hold a Blank Biome Note and use it on an ordinary block to record the biome at that block. The note gains a biome name and description without being consumed. Using it on another block replaces its record. Using it in the air does not record anything.

Craft the standalone note from paper, an ink sac and a compass using the crafting page in this chapter. As another recording tool, craft a Book of Biomes from a book, a sapling, black dye, a feather and stone. Hold that book, crouch and use it on a block to record the biome; ordinary use opens the book. A recorded Book of Biomes or Extended Edition serves as a biome record for the climate-changing rite, just like a recorded note. Read the rite's own page before preparing its circle and offerings.
manual.warlockery.infusions.replication_:
Craft a Replication Staff with a Mirror diagonally above and to the right of a wooden stick. This uses the handheld Mirror made by the mirror-infusion rite, not the placed Mirror block. Read that rite to obtain the handheld Mirror first.

Use the staff on the first corner block of the area you want to copy, then on its opposite corner. Both corner blocks are included. The selection must remain in the same dimension and contain at most 512 blocks. A third use on a block copies the selection beside the face you clicked: click the top face to place the copy above it. The smallest selected X, Y and Z coordinates become the copy's starting corner.

The original blocks remain. Air and blocks that store special information, such as chests and signs, are skipped. A copy that places at least one block costs one of the staff's 512 durability; no materials or altar power are charged by this copying action. Copying can replace blocks at the destination, so choose a clear area. Crouch-use a block to clear both corners and start a new selection.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.replicatio:
Craft two Replication Charges from gunpowder, a colorless glass block and Spectral Dust. Another route is to use a Quartz Sphere on a placed Mirror with 500 available altar power nearby; this consumes the sphere and produces one charge.

Hold a charge and use it to throw it. At impact it seeks the nearest living creature other than the thrower within three blocks horizontally and two and a half blocks vertically. If a target exists and there is room to spawn, one Glass Doppelganger appears at the impact site and attacks that target. If the target is a mob, it also targets the doppelganger. The doppelganger is named for the reflected creature; this does not copy its species or equipment.

Each throw consumes one charge, even if there is no nearby target or the spawn space is blocked. Throw into open space near the intended creature. No extra altar power is needed to throw a crafted charge.
manual.warlockery.herbology.universal_an:
Craft two Universal Antidotes from a Null Catalyst, a Brew of Infection and a Brew of Wasting. Use the linked recipe for their exact ingredients.

Hold an antidote and hold Use for 1.6 seconds to drink it. It removes Poison and Wither, including both if both are active. It does not remove other harmful effects such as Slowness and does not remove beneficial effects.

Drinking consumes one antidote and returns one Glass Bottle. It can be drunk without Poison or Wither, but the bottle is still spent; it does not prevent future poison or withering.
manual.warlockery.herbology.ingredient_p:
Craft three Purified Milks from a Milk Bucket, Odour of Purity and three Clay Jars.

Hold a jar and hold Use for 1.6 seconds to drink it. Each drink removes only one active effect. Harmful effects are chosen before beneficial effects; if only beneficial effects remain, one of those is removed instead. You cannot choose which effect is removed when several have the same priority.

One Purified Milk is consumed and one Glass Bottle is returned. To remove several harmful effects, drink separate jars and check your remaining effects after each. Drinking with no active effects still consumes the milk. This is also an ingredient in the vampire and werewolf curing rites; those rites are separate from simply drinking it.
manual.warlockery.herbology.ingredient_w:
Combine one Blood Poppy with one Glass Bottle to make Warm Blood. Read the Blood Rose entry in Herbology for its plant source.

Hold Warm Blood and hold Use for 1.6 seconds to drink it. A vampire regains 20 blood reserve, up to their current maximum. Anyone who is not a vampire instead receives Hunger II for 30 seconds and gains no vampire reserve. Drinking Warm Blood does not turn a human into a vampire.

Each drink consumes one Warm Blood and returns one Glass Bottle. Use it when your vampire reserve has room; a full reserve gains nothing. Warm Blood is also a ritual ingredient, so keep any bottles required by the rite you are preparing.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.ingredient: Infernal Animus: Use

Craft one Infernal Animus from a Soul of Torment, Demonic Blood and a Demon Heart. Read the Soul of Torment entry for its creature-drop source.

Hold the animus and use it directly on a demon. A successful use consumes one animus, binds that demon's infernal allegiance to you and clears its current attack target. A demon already directly bound to another player rejects it without consuming the animus. Ordinary animals and non-demons cannot be bound this way. Emberhorn Archfiends, Abyssal Regents and Naamah are immune.

Bound demons within 32 blocks can receive your combat target: the creature you last hurt, or the creature that last hurt you. This is not an unconditional taming tool and does not override an existing direct pact with another player. Keep clear of immune demons; the item does not make them safe to approach.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.sungrenade:
Craft two Sun Grenades with a Quartz Sphere in the center, Glowstone Dust above it and on both sides, and a Sunflower below it. Crafted grenades have sunlight strength 3.

For a charged alternative, place a Sun Collector beside a Daylight Detector with open sky above. During dawn through noon it samples the detector once a second and stores its strongest signal. Use a Quartz Sphere on the collector while it holds charge and its sky is still clear: the held spheres become Sun Grenades with that stored strength, and the collector's charge is emptied. Stored afternoon charge remains usable; a collector with no charge cannot convert spheres.

Use a grenade to throw it. On impact, living targets within five blocks horizontally and three vertically take fire damage, including you if you are close. The damage is 4 plus 0.4 per sunlight strength; a crafted grenade therefore deals 5.2 damage. Undead and vampires take double damage and burn for eight seconds. Other creatures still take the base damage but are not ignited by the grenade. Each throw consumes one grenade, so throw clear of yourself and your allies.

Collecting Fumes includes the Sun Collector crafting and usage pages for the charged alternative.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.ingredient: Soul of Torment: Use

A player-killed Abyssal Regent drops one Soul of Torment. Keep the soul intact if you intend to use it as a tool; crafting Infernal Animus consumes it as an ingredient.

Hold the soul and use it directly on a living creature that is not a player. A successful use sends that creature to the Abyss and costs one durability, then starts a three-second cooldown. The soul has 64 durability. Players cannot be banished by this item. Using it in the air does nothing.

The banished creature arrives alive on a small blackstone platform prepared in the Abyss. Banishment is not a kill and does not award the creature's drops. The soul does not return the creature or teleport you with it. Choose the target carefully before using it.

The Brew of Summon Abyssal Regent calls this creature. Read its entry in The Warlock's Cauldron Codex for preparation, then make room and prepare for a hostile, unbound demon before throwing it. The Infernal Animus cannot bind an Abyssal Regent.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.leechchest:
Place a Leech Chest, hold a Sympathetic Vial, and use the chest to collect a binding. It samples the nearest other living creature within five blocks and deals that creature 1 damage. Keep only the intended target nearby to avoid collecting the wrong binding.

The chest remembers its last three visitors or sampled creatures. With no other creature nearby, it can copy the most recent remembered binding other than yours into the held vial. Empty-handed use records you as a visitor. Inspect the vial before using it in a doll or ritual.

This chest collects sympathetic bindings; it is not an item-storage chest. Its crafting page is in this chapter.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.shadedglas:
Place Shaded Glass and connect a lever or another redstone power source. Without power it lets skylight through. Power changes it to its dark state, which blocks skylight; removing power makes it clear again.

Use it as a controllable roof or window. Its state follows redstone immediately, including when first placed. The crafting page in this chapter makes eight blocks.

This is the dark, powered state of Shaded Glass. Place it beside an active redstone power source to keep it dark and block skylight. Without power it becomes clear immediately; that change is normal.

A lever lets you switch between the two states. Craft ordinary Shaded Glass using the recipe in this chapter, then power it.
manual.warlockery.infusions.bitingbelt:
Put the Biting Belt into your legs slot through your inventory. To charge it first, hold the belt in one hand and a potion in the other, then use the belt. The potion is consumed. A new charge replaces the stored effects; a potion with several effects stores its first helpful effect and its first harmful effect.

While worn, the belt renews its stored helpful effect about once each second. When a living attacker hurts you, the belt strikes back for two health points before that creature's defenses, slows it for three seconds, and applies the stored harmful effect. The belt can bite even without a stored potion. It does not prevent the incoming hit or retaliate against falls and other hazards without a living attacker.
manual.warlockery.infusions.emberstep_sl:
Wear Emberstep Slippers in your feet slot. Their Fire Protection IV enchantment reduces fire damage and shortens burning. You can put them on by using the held slippers or by moving them into the boots slot in your inventory.

They are protective footwear, not complete immunity to fire or lava. You still take damage, and the slippers wear down. There is no separate ability to activate. Use a Potion of Fire Resistance when you need protection beyond what these boots provide.
manual.warlockery.infusions.hedge_crones:
Wear the Hedge Crone's Hat in your head slot while brewing. When a machine finishes a brew, the hat gives two independent one-in-four chances to add another copy of its output, within the item's stack limit. Open a kettle yourself before its brew starts so it recognizes you as its brewer. For other machines, stay within about eight blocks when processing finishes.

The hat also clears nearby creepers' targets about once each second. A creeper can target you again, so this is not protection against an explosion already underway.

With an active infusion and at least eight reserve in your selected path, a damaging hit has a one-in-four chance to spend eight reserve and attempt a short random teleport. A successful landing cancels that hit. The attempt can spend reserve even when no landing succeeds. The Infusion Practice chapter explains paths and reserve; the hat does not create an infusion by itself.
manual.warlockery.infusions.necromancerr:
Wear Necromancer Robes in your chest slot. About once each second, they clear the targets of nearby undead creatures that are pursuing you, within roughly sixteen blocks. The creatures are not tamed or bound to you, and they can target you again.

Stay within about eight blocks of a working brazier for a 45% chance of an extra copy of a non-brew item output when it finishes. This does not multiply summoned creatures or the brazier's effects, and a normal yield is still possible. Follow Conjuration and Fetishes for the brazier's ingredients, power and ignition. Brewing outputs use brewing clothes instead of the robes' brazier bonus.
manual.warlockery.infusions.silverhelm:
Wear the Silver Helmet in your head slot for ordinary armor protection and a painful response to a werewolf's attack. When a werewolf hurts you, each silver armor piece you are wearing contributes one health point of retaliation before the attacker's defenses. You do not need a complete set.

Every worn silver piece loses one extra durability when this retaliation triggers. The helmet's bite does not cancel the incoming attack and does not trigger against ordinary creatures. Add a Silver Chestplate, Silver Leggings and Silver Boots for stronger combined retaliation; these are different from the complete Werewolf Hunter sets.
manual.warlockery.infusions.silverchestp:
Wear the Silver Chestplate in your chest slot. Besides ordinary armor protection, it contributes one health point of retaliation before the attacker's defenses whenever a werewolf hurts you. A single silver piece works, and every additional worn silver piece strengthens the same response.

Every worn silver piece loses one extra durability when it retaliates. You still suffer the original attack, and ordinary creatures do not trigger this silver response. Combine it with a Silver Helmet, Silver Leggings and Silver Boots; a Silvered Werewolf Hunter set has its own separate rules.
manual.warlockery.infusions.silverleggin:
Wear Silver Leggings in your legs slot. They provide ordinary armor protection and contribute one health point of retaliation before the attacker's defenses when a werewolf hurts you. The response works without a complete set and becomes stronger with each additional silver armor piece worn.

Each worn silver piece spends one extra durability whenever it retaliates. This does not prevent the incoming attack or retaliate against ordinary creatures. A Silver Helmet, Silver Chestplate and Silver Boots complete the silver suit; do not confuse it with Silvered Werewolf Hunter clothing.
manual.warlockery.infusions.silverboots:
Wear Silver Boots in your feet slot. Alongside ordinary armor protection, they contribute one health point of retaliation before the attacker's defenses whenever a werewolf hurts you. Each additional worn silver armor piece adds to that response; no complete set is required.

Every worn silver piece loses one extra durability when this happens. The boots do not cancel the original hit, and attacks by ordinary creatures do not trigger the silver response. Combine them with a Silver Helmet, Silver Chestplate and Silver Leggings for stronger retaliation.
manual.warlockery.infusions.witchhat:
Open your inventory and put the Warlock's Hat in the head armor slot. While you wear it, nearby Creepers that target you have their target cleared about once each second, within roughly twelve blocks. They can choose you again, so keep your distance from a swelling Creeper.

When a machine completes a brew, the hat gives an independent 35% chance to add an extra copy of the output. Wear Warlock Robes as well for a second 35% roll: both rolls can succeed, giving up to three times the normal output. Extra copies are limited by each output stack's maximum size, and an ordinary batch can still produce no bonus.

For a kettle, open or fill it while idle, then promptly start your batch to register yourself as its brewer. Keep the hat equipped until it finishes. At other brewing machines, stay within about eight blocks when the batch finishes. The hat's bonus applies to brew output, not every machine recipe.
manual.warlockery.infusions.witchrobe:
Open your inventory and put Warlock Robes in the chest armor slot. While you wear them, nearby Creepers that target you have their target cleared about once each second, within roughly twelve blocks. Creepers can target you again; the robes do not guarantee safety from an explosion.

When a machine completes a brew, the robes give an independent 35% chance to add an extra copy of the output. A Warlock's Hat adds its own 35% roll, so wearing both can yield up to three times the normal output. Extra copies stop at each output stack's maximum size. Neither piece guarantees a larger batch.

For a kettle, open or fill it while idle, then promptly begin the batch so you are recorded as the brewer. Keep the robes equipped until the batch finishes. At other brewing machines, stay within about eight blocks at completion. Recipes without brew output receive no bonus from these robes.

Mixing base, Silvered and Dawn pieces leaves those complete-set powers inactive.
